yiddish.t:
n. 意第绪语,依地语(犹太人使用的国际语)
a. 意第绪语的,依地语,<俚>犹太人的
yiddish.d: n. a dialect of High German including some Hebrew and other words; spoken in Europe as a vernacular by many Jews…

yield.t:
n. 生产量, 投资收益
vt. 出产, 给予, 让出, 放弃, 使屈服
vi. 出产, 屈服, 投降, 倒塌
yield.d:
n. an amount of a product
v. be the cause or source of

yielder.t: n. 让步者, 屈服者,提供产品的人
yielder.d: n a person who yields or surrenders

yielding.t:
a. 生产的, 屈从的, 柔顺的, 易弯曲的
[化] 屈服
yielding.d:
s. inclined to yield to argument or influence or control
s. lacking stiffness and giving way to pressure

yin.t: n. 中国思想里的“阴”（与“阳”相对）；中国的殷代；（苏格兰）一个（等于one）
yin.d: n. the dark negative feminine principle in Chinese dualistic cosmology

yip.t:
n. 犬吠声, 叫喊声
vi. 尖声狂吠, 尖声叫喊
yip.d: n. a sharp high-pitched cry (especially by a dog)

yippee.t: interj. (表示开心、快乐)咦吡, 好啊
